author: cellish
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
14

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
Sam#4803

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
Not sure, variating. About 3-5 hours per week on the build server maybe?
Currently working on a map on Alex's build server aswell.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
When I think about some people who actually might apply this question gets alot easier. I think I might be a bit better at most of them at building. Like whenever I build something I think of the things with detail, space for pvp etc. What's needed on a map to get it accepted. I think that I might be better at decorating and sometimes I just overdecorate shit. As I haven't built that many "terrain" themed builds I've been starting to just practice that kind of stuff on normal worlds and since I started I think that I have improved that by alot. And by those I think who would apply they haven't built any "terrain" themed builds of what I can see which might be good for me as I might be a bit better at it than them. 

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?'
Im not really sure what this question means. I asked Clijmart and he didn't know either so I'll go for what I think it means.
So basically I think it is asking me what I usually think about the requirements a map needs to get accepted and have good gameplay.

The 2 main things I think about while making a map is space for pvp and detail. I don't want the map overdetailed, but I don't want too less detail either because that will just make it look too simple. Space for pvp is usually very important for a map to have good gameplay, depending on what kind of gamemode you're playing. Also I think about how laggy it is going to be. If the map is big, and has alot of different blocks etc. It usually causes lag for some people who doesn't have the best computer. I also think about making the map unique. Not too unique, but I try to make it unique in a way so people like it. 

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
I have never ever tried XML so I have nooo clue at all of how to XML. But I can try and learn it if someone can teach me.

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
I would probably focus on building maps as I have absolutely no clue of how to XML but I hope I can improve that and learn how to do!

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
That was quite long ago and they're not good. The most recent ones aren't submitted but I can take some pics.

Daisy - https://avicus.net/forums/0f81a87c9?page=1 (made this one long ago, people liked it on the post then like everyone hated it. and I'd say I've improved alot since that)

Atlantis - https://avicus.net/forums/64780b535?page=1 (Also long ago)

Ik those maps aren't the best because they're quite old and I haven't really uploaded any maps in a while but I'll see if I find more.

Horrido TE - https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/e5b6cc760

Elf Town - https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/2f72f64f5

Prima Vera - https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/2eb63f142

Sahara - https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/7791b1419

Atlantis 2 - https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/a9951cd08 (So basically this one have been updated alot, I haven't made a post on the updated version though and the map is on Clijmart's build server and I can't get on that one rn Idk why. So basically if you look at the images, the iron was split up into 2 islands with iron and between them a percentage monument looking like a trident. Middle was edited by putting 2 outer islands besides the middle island that has a little thing going underground so you can bridge from 2 ways (under and above) on each side. Also the monuments were moved closer to the islands that are next to them which was requested by some people.

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
As I said, Im terrible at creating XML as I've never tried but once again, I can learn if someone teaches me. the XML has been made by other people who knows how to do it so yea.
Anyways, I've been building in minecraft kind of ever since I started playing the game. I never really improved since I started watching a youtuber called Grian which was like 1.5 years ago. I like variating with blocks and making things people usually dont think about building. I also like building with random blocks, let me explain. You basically tell someone to say 9 different building blocks, then you build a map out of it! I've tried this sometimes on normal worlds and it has turned out decent but Im getting better. I am also a builder on the Valux Network as they thought my builds were interesting and they needed someone who built things unique. So basically I'd say I have quite alot of experience.

Servers I've Built Maps For: (Wont give IPs)
Valux - Built some maps, still building on some.
Mineplex - never submitted any maps cus i was nub and didnt know how to do
Hypixel - same as mineplex
Avicus - submitted some maps
Normal Worlds - built a ton


Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
I want to become a builder because I like builder (lol that answer). So yea, ofc I like building otherwise I wouldn't have applied. Anyways I like variating with blocks and building unique things people usually don't think of building. Which could be quite good for the server as many people think that it's quite boring with the same rotation for a very long time. So if the rotation were updated often it'd be really nice. And what I mean with that, is that if more people make maps, the rotation is also (maybe) being updated more often as there's more maps to play and tryout. I've noticed that people give me feedback on my maps and they almost always has something to change. I don't take it bad, but I mean, if you can make a perfect map that gets 100% good feedback that's great. So basically my goal would be to make one of those maps. 

How do you think you will help the map development team?
As I've said probably 3 times now, I'm not good at XML. But. If I could learn how to XML there's +1 person to do XML for maps. Which always is something positive. As I like building, I think that I could bring many maps to Avicus in a not too big amount of time. I could also bring unique and variated maps to the server which would be good. Mostly all of the maps work kind of the same and mostly all of them look similiar in some way. But if I could make a map that doesn't look too similiar to any other maps, which is completely unique. That'd be great.

-Thanks!

Sam
